confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not live prices or verified July 2026 quotes; only the RBA rate was looked up online. Argentina's inflation and peso volatility make local prices and USD values unstable, and USD figures depend on which peso rate a visitor effectively pays. Local examples were checked against an assumed working rate of about 1,500 ARS per USD, which was not verified. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from their relation to the beer anchor (cocktail about twice beer, wine glass slightly above beer) because direct knowledge of current bar prices is weak. Lodging anchors are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; holistic South American capital basis (for example Montevideo or Santiago), adjusted to Buenos Aires price levels from general knowledge.
